digest_title: Cisco Crosswork Fix Requires Release-Level Deployment Verification
dek: Cisco addresses four critical vulnerabilities in Crosswork Planning without workarounds.
overview: Cisco released a critical security hardening update for Crosswork Planning covering four CVE records with no known malicious use or workarounds available.

stories.headline: Cisco Crosswork Hardening Release Fixes Critical Vulnerabilities
stories.summary: Cisco published a critical security hardening release for Crosswork Planning fixing four vulnerability classes without workarounds or malicious use.
stories.why_it_matters: Defenders must verify actual running software versions to ensure complete risk closure.

operating_view: Maintain rigorous inventory tracking and rely on release-level validation rather than incomplete dashboard metrics.
watch_items: Verify running software release levels across all Crosswork Planning instances.
Restrict management access to dedicated administrative networks during upgrade preparations.
Monitor administrative activity and database errors around the management plane.
